title: Full-Stack Developer 2026 — Guided Course
subtitle: A casual, step-by-step code-along path from web foundations to production full-stack and enterprise engineering.

tracks.title: Web Runtime & Developer Mental Models
tracks.description: Understand the machine, process, network, browser, server, and terminal boundaries before frameworks.

tracks.title: HTML, CSS & Accessible UI Foundations
tracks.description: Build the first static TaskFlow interface while learning semantics, layout, responsive design, and accessibility.

tracks.title: JavaScript Programming — TaskFlow Lite
tracks.description: Learn programming through a steadily growing TaskFlow Lite application instead of disconnected syntax demos.

tracks.title: TypeScript — From JavaScript to Safe Contracts
tracks.description: Migrate working JavaScript into explicit, maintainable contracts and understand where compile-time safety ends.

tracks.title: React — TaskFlow Lite Application
tracks.description: Build a complete frontend-only TaskFlow Lite while learning state, forms, effects, composition, and component boundaries.

tracks.title: Next.js 16 — App Router in Production
tracks.description: Turn React knowledge into a production web application using explicit server/client boundaries and observable data flow.

tracks.title: NestJS 12 + Fastify 5 — Backend Architecture
tracks.description: Trace requests through the framework and build backend behavior with explicit ownership and dependency boundaries.

tracks.title: HTTP & REST Engineering
tracks.description: Use browser DevTools and raw requests to understand the protocol your frontend and backend actually speak.

tracks.title: PostgreSQL + Supabase — Data Engineering
tracks.description: Learn SQL and relational behavior directly before asking Prisma to abstract it.

tracks.title: Prisma 7 — ORM, Migrations & Data Modeling
tracks.description: Use Prisma without losing sight of the SQL schema, migration risk, and database behavior underneath.

tracks.title: Professional API & Business Logic
tracks.description: Build CRUD, validation, errors, services, filtering, search, sorting, and pagination as one coherent API.

tracks.title: Authentication, Authorization & Multi-Tenancy
tracks.description: Treat identity and permissions as separate trust decisions and prove access control with adversarial tests.

tracks.title: Forms, TanStack Query & State Architecture
tracks.description: Build complete UI states and make deliberate decisions about forms, URL state, server state, and optimistic mutations.

tracks.title: Realtime, Storage & Collaboration
tracks.description: Add collaboration without confusing server truth, cache state, realtime events, and storage authorization.

tracks.title: Testing, Security, Observability & Performance
tracks.description: Make quality observable through tests, threat-driven labs, production evidence, and measurement-first performance work.

tracks.title: Docker, CI/CD, Vercel & Production Delivery
tracks.description: Package, verify, release, deploy, observe, and roll back TaskFlow as a production system.

tracks.title: Enterprise Systems & Architecture Transfer
tracks.description: Transfer the TaskFlow architecture into procurement, inventory, HRIS, payroll, and other business systems without cargo-culting patterns.
